description: This file implements a TPM resource manager for handling TPM objects and their lifecycle, including resource allocation, deallocation, and context management, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: EsysLock
classes.description: A lock wrapper for the ESYS_CONTEXT to ensure thread-safe access.

classes.name: TpmResourceManager::ObjectSlot
classes.description: Represents a slot for a TPM object, managing its lifecycle and resource cleanup.

classes.name: TpmResourceManager
classes.description: Manages TPM resources, including object slots, context, and synchronization.

methods.name: EsysLock
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the lock with the given ESYS_CONTEXT and mutex guard.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::ObjectSlot::ObjectSlot
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an object slot with a resource manager and optional resource handle.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::ObjectSlot::~ObjectSlot
methods.description: Destructor that releases the TPM resource if allocated.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TPM resource manager with a given ESYS_CONTEXT.

methods.name: ~TpmResourceManager
methods.description: Destructor that checks for outstanding object slots and logs fatal error if any remain.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::Esys
methods.description: Returns an EsysLock object for thread-safe access to the ESYS_CONTEXT.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::ReserveSlot
methods.description: Reserves a new object slot if available, otherwise decrements used slots and returns nullptr.
